items.html: Thus it is found that the entire Partzuf ZON was not made from the vessels of the Nekudim of BON alone. Rather, when their lights rose in the secret of Ibur and clothed in the NHY of Arich Anpin, they acquired new vessels there through this clothing, and then the first vessels that had shattered were clarified. And from these two kinds of vessels, the Partzuf ZA was made. And so it was likewise with the Nukva.
